summary: 8 AI-aesthetic tells on a new screen: purple/blue gradient, glassmorphism, rounded-3xl chips, hover:scale-105, emoji decoration, oversized centered display type, missing tabular-nums, flat hierarchy.

findings.message: bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-600 via-blue-500 to-indigo-700 is the canonical 'AI dashboard' background. Reference lock is slate-based.
findings.suggestion: Replace with neutral background (bg-white or bg-slate-50) per docs/design/reference/invoice-list.png.

findings.message: backdrop-blur-xl + bg-white/10 + shadow-2xl — glassmorphism is Tell #2 (frosted layers as decoration).
rounded-full status chips for All/Paid/Pending/Overdue is Tell #4 (word-chip UI).
findings.suggestion: Text tabs with a bottom-border for active state.

findings.message: ✨ and 💰 as decoration is Tell #7 (decorative emoji signaling AI-generated content).
findings.suggestion: Remove; the number itself is the primary information.

findings.message: Money column lacks tabular-nums — digits will misalign per-row.
findings.suggestion: Add class="tabular-nums" to the amount column.

findings.message: p-10 outer + p-6 inner + gap-3 chips = 3× reference density.
